text:
Lena (VP People): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — quick follow-up thread for live Q&A we didn't get to. Drop short questions and we'll triage.

Jordan (IC): Hi! Quick one — when is the final promo window cutoff for this cycle? I heard "late April" in the meeting but wanted a concrete date.

Ava (People Ops): Good question — cutoff for packet submission is 2026-04-25 EOD PT. Calibration meetings start the week of 2026-05-05.

Ravi (Eng Manager): If a packet misses that cutoff due to extenuating circumstances (health/family), what's the process?

Ava (People Ops): We have an exception workflow. Managers should file an "exception request" via the people-ops portal (link in #people-ops-pinned). Include a short note + supporting docs. People Ops will review and notify within 7 business days.

Sam (Recruiter): Related — for ICs who have new offers in the market, is there any fast-track for comp adjustments during the cycle?

Chris (CTO): We try to avoid mid-cycle ad-hoc comp changes unless it's to match an external offer (win-back) or clear market misalignment. Those are handled case-by-case with compensation & finance. Ping me & Ava if you need an escalation.

Jordan (IC): Thanks. Also, how are leveling questions handled if someone thinks their role mapping is off?

Ava (People Ops): Two paths: 1) Manager-led leveling request during calibration (you should discuss and raise in the packet), or 2) Post-cycle appeal — raises are reviewed during the next cycle unless it's an urgent mismatch impacting role responsibilities. We prefer manager-initiated during packet prep.

Lena (VP People): Small note — if you're an IC considering a role-level change for career trajectory (e.g., expecting to take on manager duties), flag it early in your 1:1s so managers can plan for evidence collection.

Jordan (IC): Got it. One more: does parental leave affect calibration or promotion eligibility?

Ava (People Ops): No — parental leave is protected. We use role & impact windows, and we account for approved leaves. If the contribution window is truncated, managers can provide context in the packet.

Ravi (Eng Manager): Can people include cross-team project impact in packets? We had a contributor on infra who helped a different squad. What evidence is best?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — include measurable outcomes: PRs merged, uptime improvements, benchmarks, stakeholder emails, and short quotes. Short bullets are best. Example snippet managers can paste: 

```
Cross-team: Led KV cache refactor for billing service — reduced P99 latency by 30ms, deploy success rate +8%, stakeholder note from @pay-team lead.
```

Jordan (IC): Nice. Will managers get a checklist to help assemble these?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — we uploaded a "packet checklist" PDF to the HR drive and added a small packet prep playbook in the people-ops repo. I'll DM links.

allhands-bot: New doc uploaded: packet-checklist-2026-v1.pdf (uploaded by Ava).

Sam (Recruiter): A practical ask — can we have a short FAQ about market comp bands for eng vs. product roles? Lots of questions from candidates.

Chris (CTO): Good call. People Ops + Recruiting will collaborate on a public-facing FAQ (high level only). Internal band details remain restricted.

Lena (VP People): If no one objects, we'll schedule an optional 30min "packet prep" office hour next Wednesday 9am PT. Managers + ICs welcome.

Ravi (Eng Manager): Works for me. Can you record?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — will record and post notes + a template.

Jordan (IC): Appreciate it — that'll help a lot. :thumbsup:

Lena (VP People): Thanks all — keep the short Qs here and we'll update the thread with links and the office hour invite.

Ava (People Ops): Quick links I'll drop after this: packet checklist, exception request form, office hour calendar invite, and the short packet template.

Jordan (IC): One final micro-ask — will promotions show up in Workday automatically once approved, or is there an HR action required?

Ava (People Ops): People Ops runs an ingest after approvals and update Workday. There may be a 1–3 business day lag. Managers will get a confirmation email when it's done.

Lena (VP People): Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now — we'll post the office hour + materials shortly.
